system.description: You can terrify foes with illusions created from their own fears. Make separate Intellect attacks against up to five creatures within long range. Success means a creature flees in terror, pursued by their nightmares until they've fled at least a very long distance or you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Failure means the creature ignores the images, which do not hamper them in any way. Action.
